{{Short description|Statistical software}}
{{for|the [[renewable energy]] [[Microgeneration (energy)|microgeneration]] program|Green Energy Act 2009#MicroFIT}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Microfit''' is a [[List of statistical packages|statistics package]] developed by [[Bahram Pesaran]] and [[M. Hashem Pesaran]], and published by [[Oxford University Press]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://global.oup.com/booksites/content/microfit/authors/ |title=OUP Companion web site:About the authors |website=global.oup.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222090155/https://global.oup.com/booksites/content/microfit/authors/ |archive-date=2015-12-22}}</ref> It is designed for econometric modelling with [[time series]] data.<ref>{{cite journal |first=C. R. |last=McKenzie |first2=Sumiko |last2=Takaoka |title=Microfit 5.0 |journal=[[Journal of Applied Econometrics]] |year=2013 |volume=28 |issue=1 |pages=170–175 |doi=10.1002/jae.2308 }}</ref>
